findings.reason: The cited evidence shows symptoms (alarms, volume spike) but does not establish the causal link to a traffic surge or reduced speeds.
T1 and ALR-0005 explicitly state RRC success drops and latency spikes on both sites starting at 17:15.
ANM-000056 explicitly reports a dl_volume_mb spike on S-TUN-013 with z 28.0.
ANM-000061 and ANM-000067 confirm latency spike to 108 ms and drop rate spike on S-TUN-018.
ALM-000114 and ALM-000115 show HIGH_PRB alarms on both sites within the 17:26-18:23 window, matching the anomalies.
T15 output shows prb_util pct at 100 for C-TUN-018-1 at 17:45 and 18:00, confirming the claim.
